Kittitas Weather

KITTITAS WEATHER

Welcome to the City of Kittitas Website

The city of Kittitas welcomes you. Established in 1883 as part of the westward expansion of the Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul, and Pacific Railroad. We are located in central Washington where we enjoy four seasons punctuated by crisp cold winters and nice warm dry summers. Come check us out!

TextMyGov Announcement
The City of Kittitas is launching an improved text alert system soon. Residents can expect to receive notifications about local emergencies, utility service disruptions and other important community updates. Residents may receive an initial text message notification from the number 91896. This is a legitimate text message from the City of Kittitas. Users may opt-out from all texts at any time by texting STOP. Depending on your carrier plan, text message rates may apply. If you have any questions or would like additional information, please contact the City of Kittitas office, Monday – Thursday 8am – 6pm, at (509) 968-0220.
